channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Gold holds near $4,200 as traders weigh US-Iran deal prospects
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) consolidates on Friday as traders await further developments on a potential US-Iran peace deal. At the time of writing, XAU/USD is trading flat around $4,200 after recovering from a nearly seven-month low of $4,023 touched the previous day.

item.title: British Pound: Policy divergence seen weigh against Euro – Nomura
item.description: Nomura’s Global FX Strategy team, including Dominic Bunning and Yusuke Miyairi, argues that a more hawkish ECB path versus the Bank of England should support the Euro against the Pound.

item.title: Michigan Consumer Sentiment Index expected to remain weak in June amid elevated inflation
item.description: The University of Michigan (UoM) will release the preliminary estimate of June’s Consumer Sentiment Index on Friday.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Bulls struggle to breach a previous support near 1.1600
item.description: The Euro (EUR) has given away previous daily gains against the US Dollar (USD) and is trading practically flat, at 1.1575 at the time of writing.

item.title: US Dollar: Higher-for-longer backdrop supports USD – MUFG
item.description: MUFG analysts Lin Li, Michael Wan, Lloyd Chan and Khang Sek Lee argue that firmer US inflation and resilient labour markets underpin a higher-for-longer global rates backdrop, supporting the US Dollar.

item.title: Euro: Seen drifting toward 1.1400 against US Dollar – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s Elias Haddad reports that EUR/USD briefly dipped toward 1.1500 after the ECB decision before rebounding on the US-Iran breakthrough. Haddad expects EUR/USD to edge lower and stabilize closer to 1.1400 as US growth outperforms the Eurozone.

item.title: Indian Rupee extends recovery as US-Iran to sign MoU on Sunday
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) rises sharply higher higher against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday. The USD/INR pair tumbles to near 95.12 on reports that the United States (US) and Iran will sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) in Geneva on Sunday, resulting in a significant decline in oil prices.

item.title: British Pound picks up as Iran peace hopes offset soft UK GDP data
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) maintains a moderately positive tone against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday, as investors’ optimism about a US-Iran peace deal has offset rather uninspiring UK data.

item.title: Brazilian Real: Downside risk against US Dollar – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale analysts reports USD/BRL has been rebounding from an interim low near 4.88 and is approaching the 200-DMA and a descending trend line around 5.25. They stress the need to see if a base and trend reversal can form, with resistance at 5.32/5.34 and downside risk if 4.99 fails.

item.title: IRNA releases key terms under US-Iran MoU
item.description: Iran’s IRNA news agency releases the major terms of the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) discussed with the United States (US). Earlier a report from Bloomberg showed that the MoU will be signed in Geneva on Sunday.

item.title: Fed: Warsh debut expected to stay cautious – Nordea
item.description: Nordea’s Jan von Gerich expects Kevin Warsh’s first FOMC meeting on 17 June to deliver a more neutral policy stance, with earlier projected rate cuts likely removed from the dot plot and some hike calls appearing.

item.title: European Central Bank: Hikes rates with hawkish tone – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank’s European economists highlight that the ECB delivered its first rate hike since 2023, lifting the deposit rate to 2.25% and pairing it with hawkish messaging from President Lagarde.

item.title: WTI Oil falls for second day as US-Iran deal hopes erode Hormuz risk premium
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) extends its decline for a second consecutive day on Friday, trading around $82.90 at the time of writing as investors unwind defensive positions following fresh signs of easing tensions in the Middle East.

item.title: India’s Consumer Price Index accelerates to 3.93% YoY in May. What higher inflation means for USD/INR?
item.description: India’s Consumer Price Index data for May has come in at an annualized pace of 3.93% in May, slower than 4% estimates, but higher than the previous reading of 3.48%.

item.title: Gold Price Forecast: Mean-reversion move to 20-day EMA looks likely
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) holds onto Thursday’s strong recovery move to near $4,220 during the European trading session on Friday. The precious metal reflects strength amid intensified hopes that the United States (US) and Iran will sign a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) by the weekend.

item.title: Silver Price Forecasts: XAG/USD bulls eye $69.00 amid an improved market mood
item.description: Thursday’s EuropeanSilver (XAG/USD) retraces previous losses on Friday's European session, returning to levels in the mid-range of the $67.00s at the time of writing.

item.title: Polish Zloty: Political veto risk weighs on PLN – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Tatha Ghose highlights that President Karol Nawrocki has rapidly accumulated a record number of vetoes, blocking key legislation on crypto assets, taxation and healthcare. Ghose expects Nawrocki to continue obstructing reforms until the 2027 elections.

item.title: US Dollar: Upside risks persist on resilient data – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s Elias Haddad notes that the positive shift in US-Iran relations initially weighed on the US Dollar (USD), but he still expects the USD to edge higher near term.

item.title: US-Iran deal will likely be signed by the weekend in Geneva – Bloomberg
item.description: According to a Bloomberg report, senior officials have said that the United States (US) and Iran are edging closer to signing an agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz as the Group of Seven (G7) world leaders are set to meet next week.

item.title: Equities: Cash, valuations and IPO supply – BNY
item.description: BNY’s Bob Savage analyzes U.S. equities using iFlow data, highlighting declining institutional cash balances, elevated valuations and record IPO issuance such as SpaceX.

item.title: Euro: Medium-term upside case versus Dollar – Nordea
item.description: Nordea’s Jan von Gerich notes that EUR/USD is stuck between 1.15 and 1.16 despite strong US data and favourable US interest rate differentials. He argues the Dollar has underperformed relative to historical patterns and still expects a higher EUR/USD in the medium term.

item.title: Silver price today: Silver falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Silver prices (XAG/USD) fell on Friday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $67.26 per troy ounce, down 0.17% from the $67.37 it cost on Thursday.

item.title: British Pound: BoE holds but hawkish risks rise – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank’s Sanjay Raja expects the Bank of England (BoE) to leave Bank Rate at 3.75% at the June meeting, with a likely 7–2 vote and Huw Pill and Megan Greene backing a hike.

item.title: United States Dollar Index holds losses as Iran peace hopes hurt safe-haven demand
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) retraces gains on Friday amid a brighter market mood.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar: Kiwi stays under pressure as growth lags – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Volkmar Baur argues that the New Zealand Dollar faces ongoing headwinds as the Iran conflict, higher energy prices and renewed inflation pressures derail a tentative economic upswing.

item.title: Australian Dollar recovers modest intraday losses vs USD; lacks follow-through buying
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) reverses an intraday dip to the 0.7020 area and climbs to the top end of its daily range during the first half of the European session on Thursday.

item.title: Indian Rupee: Flows-focused support and wider fiscal stance – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale notes that the Government of India and Reserve Bank of India (RBI) are prioritising capital inflows to support the Indian Rupee (INR) rather than tightening policy.

item.title: Forex Today: Renewed hopes of US-Iran peace deal help market mood improve
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Friday, June 12:

item.title: Australian Dollar: Rebound tests 0.7060 resistance against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note AUD/USD’s sharp rebound from 0.6979 to 0.7055 has room to extend toward 0.7060, though a clear break above this level is seen as unlikely near term.

item.title: Gold flat lines above $4,200 as bearish bias remains amid Iran uncertainty, Fed hike bets
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) recovers modest intraday losses and turns flat during the first half of the European session on Friday, though it remains below the daily peak. Despite uncertainty over the US-Iran peace deal, a steadier mood fails to help the US Dollar (USD) in preserving its gains.
